items.title: Remove Swift from automatic validation fallback discovery
items.context: Update verifier/runtime environment checks so Package.swift alone no longer causes swift test to run; Swift may only run through explicit validate.command(s) or an opt-in legacy setting.
items.userSees: koala validate --json no longer reports swift test only because Package.swift exists.

happy.desc: A temp repo with only Package.swift and no validator/config returns no-validation-entry warn/skip, not swift test execution.

edge.desc: A repo with explicit validate.commands for Swift can still opt in to running swift test.

adversarial.desc: Inline validate diagnostics/details and runtime fact labels no longer advertise swift test as a standard automatic fallback.

verificationEvidence.note: Validation protocol smoke creates a Package.swift-only temp repo and asserts discoverFallbackValidationCommands returns no swift command, validate returns koala-verifier-no-validation-entry warn/skip, and commands is empty.
Validation protocol smoke creates an explicit validate.commands entry labelled explicit swift test and verifies configured commands still run, preserving opt-in legacy Swift validation.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol && npm --prefix packages/main run test:runtime-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Verifier details and runtime fallback labels no longer advertise swift test as a standard automatic fallback; runtime fact contract still verifies validate-source coverage.

items.title: Support lattice.config.json as canonical config with koala.config.json legacy fallback
items.context: loadConfig and config diagnostics should prefer lattice.config.json while still reading koala.config.json for existing repositories; conflict handling must be visible.
items.userSees: A repository can configure validation in lattice.config.json; koala.config.json still works as a legacy fallback.

happy.desc: lattice.config.json validate.commands are loaded and used by koala validate.

edge.desc: koala.config.json remains readable when lattice.config.json is absent, with visible legacy migration diagnostics.

adversarial.desc: If both config files exist with conflicting validation config, diagnostics identify lattice.config.json as canonical winner.

verificationEvidence.note: Validation protocol smoke creates lattice.config.json with validate.commands and verifies koala-verifier-configured-commands executes the canonical lattice command.
Validation protocol smoke creates a legacy koala.config.json-only repo, verifies configured commands still load, and captures the migration diagnostic telling users to rename to lattice.config.json.

Validation protocol smoke creates both lattice.config.json and koala.config.json with conflicting commands, verifies lattice.config.json wins, koala command is not executed, and conflict diagnostics identify the canonical winner.

items.title: Update validation protocol tests and docs for Lattice-first validation
items.context: Validation smoke tests, runtime fact labels, docs, and prompts should describe Lattice/explicit validators rather than Swift fallback as current product gate.
items.userSees: Docs and test output point maintainers to lattice.config.json or validate.js, not Swift automatic fallback.

happy.desc: validation-protocol smoke covers Package.swift no-auto-Swift and lattice.config.json canonical config.

edge.desc: Existing package.json/npm fallback behavior still works.

adversarial.desc: No long-form current validation guidance treats Swift/Mac Native as the default product gate.

verificationEvidence.note: Validation protocol smoke covers Package.swift no-auto-Swift, explicit Swift opt-in, canonical lattice.config.json, legacy koala.config.json fallback, and config conflict diagnostics.

verificationEvidence.command: npm --prefix packages/main run test:validation-protocol && lattice validate --json
verificationEvidence.note: Existing package.json/npm fallback behavior still works: validation-protocol retains npm fallback coverage and lattice validate --json on the repo passed via package.json test script without invoking Swift.

verificationEvidence.command: rg -n "Swift / Package.swift 不在自动 fallback|Mac Native App 已退役|lattice.config.json" docs/requirements/decisions/testing-infra.md README.md packages/main/src/handlers/doctor.ts packages/main/src/verifier/serve.ts
verificationEvidence.note: Docs and user-facing diagnostics now state lattice.config.json is canonical and Swift/Mac Native is not an automatic validation fallback; Swift remains only explicit opt-in or legacy executor context.
